messages:
sophie: Heads up — onboarding worker backlog surfaced this morning, ~18 tenants are stalled in the provisioning queue. Standup just flagged it. Need to coordinate customer comms + mitigation.
jamal: Root cause looks like a DB lock storm from concurrent tenant migrations. I opened an infra ticket and paused new enrollments. Ticket INC-4578 in ops.
alex: Ack — pushed a partial fix (worker concurrency limit + retry jitter). Clearing the stalled jobs now, should clear ~8 in 20–25m, remaining will drain in waves. Ill update when all clear.
maria: Thanks. I can draft the customer note. Recommend: clear impact statement, ETA, steps we're taking, immediate workarounds, and a goodwill offer (credit/enablement session). Short + bulleted.
kevin: Prioritize high-touch accounts in the list (3 enterprise customers mid-onboarding). I'll reach out to their AMs directly once we have ETA.
cs-bot: Incident flagged: onboarding-queue-backlog at 2026-03-21T09:12Z. Severity: moderate. Postmortem requested within 48 hours.
sophie: For the external comms, let's aim for a single concise thread per affected account and one generic broadcast for lower-touch customers. Maria — can you post the draft here and tag me + alex for technical accuracy?
maria: Draft below (first pass):

----
Hi {{customer_name}},

We're reaching out about a temporary onboarding delay your team may see. We identified a provisioning backlog affecting a subset of new tenant signups. Impact: onboarding steps are paused and provisioning may take up to 3 hours longer than expected for affected accounts. Estimated resolution: staggered over the next 1–3 hours; core services are not impacted once provisioned.

What we're doing: we throttled concurrent migrations, applied a fix to the worker process, and are manually clearing stalled jobs. Our engineering team is monitoring until the queue is clear.

Workarounds: if you need expedited provisioning for a specific tenant, reply here with the tenant id and we will prioritize it.

Goodwill: were offering a one-week extension of your onboarding trial or a $200 account credit for affected customers. If you'd like enablement support (30–60 min session) to finish setup, we will schedule that at no cost.

We apologize for the disruption and will follow up with a short incident summary and any follow-up actions.

Link to survey: https://redwood.example/survey-onboard-incident

----

maria: Thoughts on the wording? I kept it non-technical and actionable. Open to swap the credit to % if needed.
jamal: Wording is good. Technical note: don't promise "fully resolved in 1–3 hours" — safer to say "expect queue to clear within the next few hours; we will update with exact time." Also remove any pass that suggests service downtime.
sophie: Good catch. Maria update that line + add a line that well send an RCA within 48 hours and include a contact for urgent escalations (kevin@redwood.com).
maria: Updated draft: replaced ETA with "expect queue to clear within the next few hours; we will send follow-up updates." Added RCA timing and kevin as escalation contact. Pasting final below.

----
Final customer note:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Were reaching out about a temporary onboarding delay some customers may experience. A provisioning backlog affected a subset of new tenant signups; while core services remain available once provisioned, provisioning for affected tenants may take longer than usual.

What were doing: throttling concurrent migrations, applying fixes to the worker process, and manually clearing stalled jobs. We expect the queue to clear within the next few hours and will provide follow-up updates.

If you need expedited provisioning for a specific tenant, reply with the tenant id and we will prioritize it.

Goodwill: were offering a one-week extension of your onboarding trial or a $200 account credit for affected customers. If youd like enablement support (30–60 min), we will schedule that at no cost.

We will publish an incident summary and RCA within 48 hours. For urgent escalation, contact kevin@redwood.com.

Link to quick feedback form: https://redwood.example/survey-onboard-incident

----
sophie: That looks good. Maria, queue this to go out to the 18 affected accounts in batches — start with the 3 enterprise ones and have Kevin do the AM outreach. Please add a private note per account with details (tenant id, plan, renewal window) so we can tie impact to renewal risk.
kevin: Ill call the three enterprise AMs now and offer the enablement session. For accounts in renewal Q2, suggest including a proactive credit proposal in the outreach.
maria: Will send batch #1 in 30m. Ill include the per-account private notes in the CRM entry and add a tag "onboard-backlog-2026-03-21".
jamal: From ops: once the queue is cleared, we should snapshot the stalled jobs for postmortem and attach logs to INC-4578. Also recommend a short post-incident survey in the customer follow-up to capture friction points.
sophie: Agreed — include survey link and 2 optional questions in the follow-up email. Ops, please prioritize the postmortem; engineering will aim to have a draft within 48 hours.
cs-bot: Reminder: Please upload RCA draft to /incidents/onboarding-queue-backlog by 2026-03-23T09:12Z.

sophie: Thanks team. Keep updates here; label any urgent replies from customers with "priority-onboard" so we can triage. Closing the standup thread once all affected tenants are confirmed cleared. :white_check_mark:
